intro: Joining BrindleWood takes about a minute. Java and Bedrock players are both welcome.

java.title: Java Edition (PC)
steps: Enter the address **{javaIp}** and click Done.

bedrock.title: Bedrock Edition (console, mobile, Windows)
steps: Go to **Social**, at the top right.
Search for **EuphoriaHQ7845** and add them as a friend.
bedrock.note: Bedrock players join through our friend account instead of typing in an address. Ask in our Discord if you need help joining.

gettingStarted.title: 1. Pick a Kingdom
gettingStarted.body: Read about the four kingdoms and choose the one that fits your style.

gettingStarted.title: 2. Read the Rules
gettingStarted.body: Our rules keep things fun and fair for everybody.

gettingStarted.title: 3. Say Hi on Discord
gettingStarted.body: Join our Discord to meet players, ask questions, and hear about events.
